ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white/cream pixels to 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region at the central peduncle attachment point. Dark-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are densely concentrated along the trailing edges and the median notch perimeter. Mid-lobe regions exhibit sparse, discrete low-intensity spots against a high-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-line; pixel-depth is approximately 12-15% of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and amplitude toward the distal lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately five high-intensity (white) circular ring-like pixel clusters (annuli) on the mid-portion of the left lobe; numerous smaller dark-intensity circular spots distributed across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct dark-intensity horizontal linear disruption located on the distal portion of the right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and small V-shaped indentations on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating physical erosion or trauma.
